description: Defines time-related functions and types for high-resolution time management, including getting current time, calculating elapsed time, comparing times, converting to string, and converting to timespec.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculates a time 'ms' milliseconds after a given time.

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed milliseconds between two times.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Converts a time to a human-readable string format HH:MM:SS.mmm.

methods.name: rtTime_ToTimespec
methods.description: Converts a high-resolution time to a timespec structure.
